general.label: General Simulation
general.description: A general educational model. Eligible securities count toward account-level collateral at an assumed 75%.

cash-first.label: Cash-first
cash-first.description: A conservative model. Securities produce no collateral; only cash counts as available collateral.

conservative.label: Conservative (discounted rate)
conservative.description: Securities count toward collateral but at a lower effective rate (~2/3 of nominal). Shows haircut sensitivity.

marginDisclaimer: Calculated with the selected account profile and collateral assumptions. Actual broker rates, eligibility and liquidation conditions may differ.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.description: Strong uptrend. Market and trade appreciate together.

scenarios.name: Hype
scenarios.description: Excessive optimism. Trade gets an outsized premium; portfolio rises only mildly.

scenarios.name: Peak
scenarios.description: Peak exhaustion ~ S&P correction June 2022. Trade takes a hard hit, portfolio a moderate one.

scenarios.name: Slow Bleed
scenarios.description: Slow bleed. Long-term gradual erosion, 1% drop per day.

scenarios.name: Credit Stress
scenarios.description: Silent killer. Existing portfolio loses value; trade stays flat.

scenarios.name: Tech Selloff
scenarios.description: Tech selloff ~ NASDAQ correction Q4 2022. Hits technology-heavy portfolios.

scenarios.name: Recovery
scenarios.description: Recovery. After the shock the market turns back up.

scenarios.name: Flat
scenarios.description: Price stays flat. Only carrying cost (interest) quietly accrues — this is the profit threshold.
